title: The ordinary-to-derived limit comparison has the full zero-homotopy Roos normalization
statement: For every scheme W and arbitrary cochain complex C of strict coefficient-system modules, the canonical map from the ordinary limit complex to the derived total limit, followed by pullbackTensorLimitRoos, equals localization of the actual (ordinary limit projections, zero shifted coordinate) chain lift, with the canonical complex-composition transport for restriction followed by limit. No tensor, flatness, boundedness or constructibility assumption is used. The specified maps and comparisons are those of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations].

source.place: Tags 08TC and 0941; ordinary-limit units and the full Roos model normalization.

proof.text: On K-injective restricted towers the published Roos model is rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso.hom followed by Q of the explicit zero-homotopy chain lift. The right-derived unit is the inverse of that isomorphism, so the two cancel.

The chain lift is natural: product projections and the ordinary limit projection naturality identify its first coordinate; the two shifted coordinates are zero. Naturality of the derived unit and the Roos model transports the equality from a K-injective resolution to every tower. The localized Roos map of that resolution is invertible by the published natural isomorphism.
Insert the complex-composition comparison for scalar restriction followed by limit, and cancel the derived restriction comparison with its inverse.

lean.statement:
theorem pullbackTensorLimitUnit_roos (W : Scheme.{u})
    (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E W) ℤ) :
    pullbackTensorLimitUnit l E W C ≫ (pullbackTensorLimitRoos l E W C).hom =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
          (Iso.refl (coefficientSequenceRestriction l E W ⋙
            pullbackTensorConstantLimit l E W)) (.up ℤ)).inv.app C) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (pullbackTensorRoosUnit l E W
        (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C))
